fields.name: Rosewood Puff-Sleeve Midi
fields.description: A timeless linen-blend midi dress with elegant puff sleeves and a flattering A-line silhouette. It features a tailored waist and a natural textured finish for effortless sophistication.

fields.name: Midnight Mandarin Wrap Midi
fields.description: A sophisticated sleeveless midi dress crafted from breathable textured linen. It features a modern mandarin-style collar, a deep V-neckline, and a single-button waist closure that flows into a pleated, full-bodied skirt.

fields.name: Serene Sand Linen Set
fields.description: Effortless and polished, this two-piece linen set features a relaxed-fit, V-neck top with half sleeves and matching wide-leg trousers. With a classic, breathable texture, it’s the ultimate combination of comfort and sophisticated style, perfect for lounging at home or stepping out for a casual lunch.

fields.name: Cloud Grey Smock Tunic
fields.description: Effortless and relaxed, this textured linen smock tunic features a flattering deep V-neckline and charming puff sleeves. Its loose, voluminous fit makes it a comfortable choice for layering or wearing on its own for an elevated, casual look.

fields.name: Essential V-Neck Linen Tee
fields.description: A minimalist, relaxed-fit top featuring a clean V-neckline and short, capped sleeves. This versatile piece is crafted from premium textured linen, offering a light and airy feel that transitions effortlessly from casual daywear to refined evening looks.

fields.name: Terracotta Belted Midi Dress
fields.description: This charming midi dress is crafted from a breathable linen blend, featuring a button-down bodice and a matching fabric belt to define the waist. Its relaxed cap sleeves and flowing A-line skirt create a comfortable yet polished silhouette suitable for any daytime occasion.

fields.name: Garnet Empire Midi Dress
fields.description: Designed for ultimate comfort and ease, this flowing linen-blend midi dress features a high empire waist and a softly gathered skirt. The bodice is detailed with classic wood-style buttons and versatile half-sleeves, offering a timeless silhouette that adapts beautifully to every stage of life.

fields.name: Dusty Rose Button-Front Midi
fields.description: A breezy linen-blend midi dress designed with a full-length button-front closure and a relaxed empire waist. Featuring practical side pockets and comfortable short sleeves, this lightweight piece offers a soft, feminine silhouette for effortless daywear.

fields.name: Onyx Smock Maxi
fields.description: A striking and voluminous maxi dress crafted from premium textured linen. Featuring a deep V-neckline and a high-waisted smocked bodice, this piece offers a dramatic yet comfortable silhouette with wide, elbow-length sleeves.

fields.name: Ember Smock Tunic
fields.description: A sophisticated linen tunic featuring a flattering V-neckline and a softly gathered empire waist. The three-quarter puff sleeves with elasticized cuffs add a modern touch to this breezy, relaxed silhouette.

fields.name: Golden Hour Button-Down Midi
fields.description: A vibrant and versatile midi dress featuring a classic V-neckline and a full-length button-front closure. Crafted from premium breathable linen, it offers a relaxed silhouette with short sleeves and functional side pockets for an effortless everyday look.

fields.name: Oat Linen Button-Front Smock
fields.description: A relaxed and cozy midi dress crafted from premium textured linen. This design features a full-length button-front closure, a gathered empire waist, and long sleeves with subtle elasticated cuffs. Complete with oversized patch pockets, it offers a functional yet timeless silhouette for effortless everyday wear.

fields.name: Soft Peach Button-Front Smock
fields.description: A gentle and airy midi dress featuring a full-length button-front closure and a classic gathered empire waist. Designed with long, relaxed sleeves and a comfortable flowing skirt, this piece is crafted from premium textured linen for an effortless, feminine look.

fields.name: Mulberry Smock Midi Dress
fields.description: An effortless and breezy midi dress featuring a simple round neckline and a relaxed empire waist. Designed with short cap sleeves and a softly gathered skirt, this piece is crafted from premium textured linen for a natural, comfortable silhouette perfect for warm outdoor days.

fields.name: Teal Horizon Wide-Leg Trousers
fields.description: Designed for effortless movement, these wide-leg linen trousers feature a comfortable elasticated waistband and a cropped silhouette. Crafted from breathable, high-quality linen with a natural textured finish, they offer a relaxed yet polished look perfect for versatile styling.

fields.name: Amethyst Boxy Drape Top
fields.description: A modern, architectural silhouette featuring an ultra-relaxed boxy fit and a unique high-low handkerchief hemline. Crafted from lightweight, textured linen, this statement top is designed with a wide boat neckline and exaggerated drop shoulders that flow into soft, draped sleeves for a comfortable yet artistic look.

fields.name: Sedona Linen Shift Dress
fields.description: A timeless and minimalist shift dress designed for effortless comfort. Featuring a classic scoop neckline and a sleeveless silhouette, this knee-length piece is crafted from premium breathable linen. Two spacious front patch pockets add a functional touch to its relaxed, airy fit, making it an ideal choice for warm-weather styling.

fields.name: Canyon Gathered Midi Skirt
fields.description: A timeless staple for any wardrobe, this midi skirt is crafted from high-quality, breathable linen. It features a flattering high-waisted band that leads into a softly gathered, voluminous silhouette. With its natural texture and flowing movement, it is designed for effortless elegance in both desert landscapes and city streets alike.

fields.name: Midnight Collared Smock Midi
fields.description: An elegant yet relaxed midi dress that blends classic shirting details with a breezy silhouette. Featuring a structured pointed collar and a short-button placket, this dress transitions into a softly gathered empire waist and a flowing, voluminous skirt. Crafted from premium breathable linen with short sleeves, it offers a polished look for effortless day-to-evening wear.

fields.name: Garnet Meadow Short Set
fields.description: A sophisticated and coordinated two-piece ensemble designed for effortless summer style. This set features a classic button-down shirt with a crisp collar and relaxed elbow-length sleeves, paired with tailored high-waisted shorts. Crafted from breathable, premium linen with functional side pockets, this set offers a polished yet breezy look perfect for strolling through sun-drenched European streets.

fields.name: Peter Pan Smock Midi
fields.description: Crafted from premium, breathable linen with a natural texture, this piece offers a vintage-inspired silhouette perfect for comfortable, everyday elegance.

fields.name: Balloon Culottes
fields.description: A playful and avant-garde take on the classic wide-leg trouser, featuring a dramatic balloon silhouette. Designed with a comfortable elasticated waistband and deep side pockets for maximum utility. The gathered hem creates a unique tapered effect at the mid-calf, crafted from breathable, structured linen that maintains its bold shape throughout the day.

fields.name: Tiered Cami Maxi
fields.description: An effortlessly romantic maxi dress featuring a delicate camisole-style bodice with thin adjustable straps. Designed with a relaxed, tiered silhouette that adds graceful movement and volume to the skirt. Crafted from premium, breathable linen and finished with practical side pockets, this piece offers a perfect blend of bohemian charm and modern comfort.
